verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own data. Users can query large codebases, debug issues in natural language, and get automated PR reviews with contextual feedback and suggestions, plus issue triage based on content analysis. Community reports support this: one user says it navigated very large codebases effortlessly, and another says its code review caught bugs that reviewers missed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights are produced, evidence for non-code data sources, and consistent hands-on reliability (one user reports poor codebase navigation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions
Issue Triage: Automated labeling and prioritization of GitHub issues based on content analysis
Gemini is consistently offering better code review tips. It has officially caught multiple potential bugs, even a few that reviewers might have missed.
